Named basemaps

Source: R/providers.R
basemap_provider.Rd

basemap_provider() returns the style of a named basemap, for basemap() and the other renderers' style argument. Names follow leaflet-providers ("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery", "OpenStreetMap.HOT"); list_providers() lists them with their forms, and providers completes them. A name also works as style directly; use this function to pick the form, pass a key, or draw your own tiles with the basemap's style. Implemented in the Rust core, so R and Python (basemapper.basemap_provider()) return the same style.

Usage

basemap_provider(
  name,
  type = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  tiles = NULL,
  labels = TRUE,
  features = NULL
)

Arguments

name

Basemap name (case-insensitive).

type

"vector" (a MapLibre style) or "raster" (tiles). By default the vector form when there is one, else raster. Asking for a form a basemap lacks is an error, never a silent fallback.

api_key

API key for CARTO, MapTiler and Stadia; by default read from CARTO_API_KEY, MAPTILER_API_KEY or STADIA_API_KEY. The keys are free for moderate use; list_providers() shows which basemaps need one.

tiles

Your own tile data to draw with this basemap's style: a .pmtiles archive (URL or path), tile URL or TileJSON. It must use the same schema as the provider's tiles (OpenMapTiles for OpenFreeMap and Stadia).

labels

TRUE keeps every layer, FALSE drops the labels, "only" keeps only the labels, to stack this basemap's labels over another map. Raster tiles switch to the provider's label-free or label-only tiles (an error when it has none).

features

Vector form: features to keep (c("water", "roads")) or drop ("-buildings"); see list_layers().

Value

A style string: a URL, or inline style JSON (the raster form, or with tiles, labels or features).

See also

tile_style() for your own tile data, wms_style() for OGC services.

Examples

basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty")
#> [1] "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty"
basemap_provider("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas", type = "raster")
#> [1] "{\"layers\":[{\"id\":\"raster\",\"source\":\"raster\",\"type\":\"raster\"}],\"metadata\":{\"basemapper:raster\":{\"has_labels\":false,\"labels\":[\"https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Reference/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}\"],\"provider\":\"Esri.WorldGrayCanvas\"}},\"sources\":{\"raster\":{\"attribution\":\"Tiles © Esri — Esri, HERE, Garmin, © OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS User Community\",\"maxzoom\":16,\"tileSize\":256,\"tiles\":[\"https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Canvas/World_Light_Gray_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}\"],\"type\":\"raster\"}},\"version\":8}"
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
basemap_provider("CartoDB.Voyager", api_key = "...")   # or set CARTO_API_KEY
basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", tiles = "data/area.pmtiles")
# Imagery under a vector basemap's labels
basemap(c("Esri.WorldImagery", basemap_provider("OpenFreeMap.Liberty", labels = "only")),
        center = c(-111.89, 40.76), zoom = 12)
} # }
